title: C — Context Layer
description: Persona, voice tone, temperature, and reason for being. The behavioral configuration loaded after M fires.

persona.description: One-sentence description of the agent's character.

voice_tone.description: Communication style: formal, terse, warm, sarcastic, methodical, etc.

temperature.description: Creativity vs determinism scale. 0.0 = strict, 1.0 = imaginative.

why_here.description: The reason this agent exists. The single sentence that justifies its existence.
